subject: ela
intro: On the SAT, 'Text Structure and Purpose' questions ask about the function of a particular sentence within a passage, or the overall purpose of the passage. A sentence might introduce, give an example, qualify, or conclude; the purpose is why the author wrote the passage.

items.prompt:
Read.

(1) Many believe bats are blind. (2) In fact, most bats see well. (3) They simply rely on echolocation in the dark.

What is the function of sentence (2)?

steps: Sentence (1) states a common belief; sentence (2) corrects it.
So (2) functions to correct the misconception in (1).
solution.answer: It corrects the misconception stated in sentence (1).

items.prompt: What is the overall PURPOSE of that passage?

steps: The passage sets up and then corrects a myth about bats.
So its purpose is to correct a common misconception about bats' eyesight.
solution.answer: To correct a common misconception about bats' eyesight.

items.prompt: The 'function' of a sentence is the ____ it serves in the passage.
The job a sentence does is its ____.
Why the author wrote the passage is its ____.
A sentence can introduce, exemplify, qualify, or ____.
